Initial release of Invoice Risk Scan.

- Scans key invoice elements (tax ID format, amount, date) before reimbursement/bookkeeping; flags anomalies.
- Designed for compliance screening; not a replacement for licensed professional review.
- Zero external dependencies; deterministic outputs with clear exit codes (PASS/FAIL/ERROR).
- Supports machine-readable JSON output and command-line use.
- Provides clear installation and usage instructions for multiple agent platforms.
